title: Discovering Your Kingdom Destiny
paragraphs: We'll talk about that this morning. To those joining us via television around the world, may God bless you as we continue our series on understanding the Kingdom of God. This is the Gospel. Today we will focus specifically on discovering your destiny, which is the Kingdom itself. We will focus on the fact that the Kingdom is Jesus' original mission. The Kingdom, the original mission of Jesus. I think we've already covered a lot of material in this series.

But the more I prepared to participate, the more I understood how far we had strayed as a global church. So I would like to give you some ideas to draw upon as we begin this part about discovering your destiny in the Kingdom. First and foremost, let us remember that the purpose of human creation was not really to have a religion, but to carry out a mission that God had set from the beginning. That is, God’s original purpose for man was to manage a kingdom, not a religion. The last thing God wanted was religion.

And I don't know what turned this into, but religion is a very dangerous thing because religion doesn't necessarily answer the questions of your life. The word "religion" actually means searching, and we should not search anymore if we have found the answers. The second thing I want you to remember is that the fall of man was the loss of a kingdom, not the loss of heaven, but the loss of a kingdom. The third principle I want you to remember is that the promise of redemption was to restore the kingdom.

Everything that man has lost, that is what God wanted to restore. Therefore, the redemptive work of the Lord Jesus was not to establish a religion, a worship experience, or rituals and traditions that we developed. That was not his intention. His goal and purpose for coming. His mission was to restore the lost kingdom that God had given to man. The other principle I want you to remember is that the fulfillment of God’s will is the re- establishment of His kingdom on earth.

And I want to emphasize that God's will will be done when what He intended is restored. God's will is not for man to truly be in heaven. I want you to follow the ideas of these principles. God's purpose will truly be fulfilled when man rules and governs his kingdom on Earth. This is the fulfillment of God's purpose. Therefore, until that happens, God is not pleased. God's purpose is not yet complete.

The final principle I want to emphasize is that the salvation program was intended to restore humanity to the government of the Kingdom of God. That was the program that was designed. And I like the word "program" here. I used the word " program" because it relates to systems, methods, and techniques. The program is related to objectives set to achieve an ultimate goal. So, salvation is a program. Salvation is not the goal. Salvation is the program.

Ah, when I use the term salvation, it encompasses all of God’s redemptive works. For example, the Messiah's promise is part of the program. Then the fulfillment of that promise through Mary's conception from the Spirit, the Word of God, and the birth of a child through a miraculous birth. This is part of the program. Then the child's upbringing and Jesus offering his life on the cross is part of the program. Calvary is not God's goal.

Calvary is one of the steps in the program to achieve the original and ultimate goal, which is what? Restoring God's kingdom on earth. This is what God wants. So if you don't understand this, you'll remain stuck in religion. If you do n't understand this, you will literally live until you die. You will use religion to be happy in poverty, depression, and sadness until you die. In other words, you will use religion as a pacifier rather than as a force for domination.

I will make a statement once again, and I don't want you to misunderstand me, but I mean what I say, which is that Calvary is not the Gospel. Calvary is part of the program that leads us to the good news, which is the meaning of the Gospel, namely the Kingdom of God. So I would like to reiterate a few points here. Firstly, God created you to run a kingdom. You were born to be a manager.

An administrative officer is a person who has been given responsibility through delegated authority and power to implement decisions and issue judgments on behalf of another authority. If you are given an administrative position, whether you are an executive, an administrative officer, or a department manager in a company, you are an administrator and what you have been given is delegated authority to oversee a specific area in the company.

Your job is to carry out the decisions of that company on behalf of the board of directors or the chairman of the board to fulfill the will of that company in that department. This is the meaning of management. Is this clear? This is what is called control or influence over the department, i. e. , sovereignty. This is what God has given to man. Genesis 1:26 is very clear. The first command from God to man was, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness,” and to have dominion over what?

Administrative authority, sovereignty over what? The Earth, this region called Earth. Therefore, the part over which man has been given authority is the whole earth, not the sky, but the earth. Now, if you were given administrative authority over a department that deals with correspondence or mechanics, for example, but you decided that you wanted to work in the accounting department. What do you call that? Huh? What do you call that? Mismanagement. You are stepping outside the scope of your responsibility.

You are actually acting illegally. If you enter the accounting department and try to work as an accountant, while your job is in another department, it is the same for you if you go up to heaven and try to take over there. You are illegal in heaven. It seems harsh, doesn't it? Look, the religious want to go to heaven, but the people of the kingdom want to stay on earth because that is where they are supposed to be. In fact, my boss told me, by the way, his name is Jesus Christ. He is the King, the Lord.

He said to me, " Father, do not take them out of the world." We are now praying to leave. He prayed that we would stay. Which prayer will be answered? I mean, does n't he want us to come to heaven? Doesn't he want us to be with him? I mean, doesn't he really want us to be there singing forever around the throne? That wasn't his intention for you. He said, “Father, do not take them out of the world, but keep them from the evil one in it.” Why? Because they have the power to overcome that evil.

Now, if I die, don't misunderstand me, if I die, you will go to heaven. No problem. If you die now, you will go to heaven. If you were born again, you would go to heaven. But this is not your permanent residence. If you read the Bible carefully, God has a plan to get you out of heaven after you go there. Read the Bible carefully, because you were not designed to stay in heaven. That is not your last task. The Book of Revelation, the last two chapters 21 and 22, are powerful chapters.

They conclude the book in this way. He says: “And I saw a new heaven and a new earth coming down from heaven.” How do you explain that? Because you won't stay there. God will put you on a land to rule if He has to create a new one. Clap. This is a good place to applaud. It's best to get used to this idea. So God's plan is to re-establish the kingdom that Adam lost. Adam did not fall from heaven. We talk about falling all the time, but we forget where it fell from. Adam was not in heaven, so he fell to earth.

Therefore, we do not need to bring it back up to restore its position. No, Adam has fallen from his authority on Earth. He had dominion over Heaven, and he was deceived or tricked by an idle cherub named Lucifer. Lucifer deceived man, and thus man became subject to this evil, hateful, and satanic angel. Thus, the management contract that was granted to Adam was effectively handed over by Adam to this unemployed carrion. Therefore, Adam remains the legal manager of the land. When I say Adam, I am talking about you.

All of humanity is Adam. We are still the legal authorities here. But Satan, Iblis, Lucifer, whatever name you call him, became an illegitimate ruler by subjugating the legitimate ruler through treason. What is betrayal? Betrayal is when someone entrusts you with something and you give it to someone else. Adam committed a grave act of treason. He was entrusted by God's government to administer the earth. He took that contract and gave it to someone else, thereby committing high treason.

Therefore, the ultimate form of disappointment is betrayal, because you were entrusted with something. And what did God do in the same chapter, Genesis 3, when Adam abandoned the covenant? It is the same chapter in which the government made a promise. God's government has made a promise. In verse 15, it is written that he was speaking to the evil angel.

He says to Satan, in verse 15 of chapter 3 of Genesis, “I promise you that the same woman you used to destroy the covenant of mankind, I will use a woman like her, and I myself will return to the human race,” says God, “and I will crush your head.” The word "head" refers to authority. You know, we think of the snake, the devil, as a snake. It is not a snake. The only thing is that he originally used a snake's body in that chapter. He possessed the body of a snake in order to gain legal access.

But the snake's head is the way to kill the snake's power, isn't it? Okay. If you cut off a snake's tail, it will still live. Therefore, when God says, "I will come and my offspring will crush your head." He was talking about the authority of the government. He was talking about the power that this evil creature had stolen from Adam. He says: I will regain power and I will destroy your influence. He is talking about the authority of the government. So why did God send Jesus?

Well, according to Genesis 3:15, he was sending the Messiah, the offspring, to restore God’s government to earth. Could you please open with me a few biblical verses that we have dealt with before in Isaiah chapter 9, verses 6 and 7, which say: “ For to us a child is born, to us a son is given.” What does the following phrase say? The presidency rests on his shoulders. The reason Christ came was not to be a little baby lying in a manger like Santa Claus and reindeer.

No, the purpose for which he came was to bring what? It is not a church, it is not a religion, it is not a tradition. But what was the reason he came? Not for singing songs, clapping hands, and praising the Lord. No, what is he coming to do? To carry a government on his shoulders. The word shoulder here refers to the place where you carry something like a burden. In the days of Isaiah, when you had a servant, they would put wood across their necks and bear the burden to balance it.

It is like a yoke for a human being, and that is where they carry the burden on their shoulders just like a cow. They call it a yoke. A yoke placed around the cow's shoulders. Well, humans also wore the yoke in the days of Jesus and the days of Isaiah. They would place buckets on both sides or something else. They would balance it on their shoulders, and that's how they carried the weights for others. Read it. He says here: Because a child is born to us. Yes, he is coming. He is given a son. This is a revelation.

And when he comes, he comes carrying a burden on his shoulders. What is this weight? It is not a church, nor a religion, nor a tradition, but rather it brings back to the earth what? Say it out loud. I can't hear you. Say it again. He is restoring a government. In other words, the reason for his coming is to restore a government that had been lost. The word "sovereignty" means to rule, to control, to manage, and to lead. So when you say that the Bible says, "Let us make man, and let him have what?" sovereignty.

The word "sovereignty" in Hebrew means to rule, to control, to manage, and to lead. So he said, "Let them have what?" government. What has humanity lost? The government has lost. What did Christ come to bring? He came to take back the government. This means you were born to be a ruler. Tell your neighbor, I love that. Be upright and act like a ruler. Let's go. Smile and hold your chests up. I feel good. I look good. I smell good because I believe I am okay.

Look, if you really get this into your head, you won't wake up every Monday morning wondering where you're going. If you are a ruler, a controller, a leader, and a manager, no job controls you. You are in control of the job. Your attitude changes when you understand why God sent you to this planet. It is to rule, control, and manage. Christ came to restore that government. And look what he says here. He says: The leadership rests on his shoulders. And what will it be called?

Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. And I tell you, one of these days in this series, we will be discussing the word "peace". The word "peace " is a powerful word. Every time he talks about Jesus and the Kingdom, he talks about peace because peace means quiet trust. Write this down. A very important word. Quiet confidence. peace. Shalom. It means quiet confidence because of what? Knowledge of prosperity.

In other words, you have a calm confidence when you know that everything is under the care of God's government. Peace comes to you when you don't have to worry about anything. Even in the midst of a storm, you can sleep like Jesus because you are in the kingdom of God. What does the following statement say? For the growth of his government, this is a profound matter. There will be no end. Let me explain something very important to you. He says that when Jesus comes, he will bring a government.

And when he brings it, I love it. God says, “Look, O people, understand this verse well.” You understood it. They moved on to the verse. Look at the last line in this entire passage. What does he say? The Lord's jealousy will do this. Isn't this wonderful? Let me tell you why this phrase is important. The jealousy of the Lord. Now listen, God is God. God is not afraid of anything. God created everything. He owns everything. Therefore, he does not need to be jealous. Can anyone here hear me? no.

Did you understand what I just said? Are you sure? Good. Look, you need jealousy because you have to fight some things. But God doesn't need to fight anything. Therefore, he doesn't need any jealousy. However, the Bible says that the Lord's jealousy will make this happen. In other words, God is saying, look, if anyone stands in my way, I will destroy him. In what sense? On his way to increasing the government that his son brings. Let me tell you why this is important.

Many of you are concerned about the growth of other religions around you. You are worried about all those doctrines, Islam, Buddhism, Confucianism, and all those trends. God says, "Look, the growth of my Son's government will have no end. It will continue to grow and expand, and it doesn't matter how they build mosques and temples; he doesn't worry about that. My government will continue to grow and grow. In other words, the whole idea of ​​growth of any other group is temporary. This is a good place to say Amen.

You all missed it. You look at me like I'm crazy. Look, I have confidence. When I enter a country like Malaysia, or go to Timbuktu, or if I enter Iran or Iraq, I look at Saddam Hussein and smile. I say, ' Guess what?'" You are on your way to extinction. Why? According to the promise, God's jealousy is against you. You do n't want God to be angry with you, do you? You know, God doesn't actually fight himself. He does not fight. God created some creatures to fight on his behalf. These are strong brothers.

We will now learn about them and their true nature. Strong brothers. These individuals are extremely powerful. One of them poured a single container on the ground. Famine spread throughout the entire land. Someone took a bowl and poured it out, and famine spread throughout the land. This one of them has destroyed the entire world economy. Another came and poured a bowl, and all the oceans dried up. It has dried completely. These are strong brothers. God does not fight. He created individuals who could fight.

Someone appears and wipes out the entire economy of the Earth. Who are these people? They are dangerous individuals. The more I learn about them, the more peace I feel in my nights. Because I thought they were fighting only for God. Hallelujah. I started to feel excited about myself. That's fine. He will reign on the throne of David, in reference, of course, to the lineage of the throne established by God.

Notice, he will reign on David’s throne and over his kingdom, establishing and supporting it, and for how long? forever. Rather, through justice and righteousness. Justice and righteousness. Oh my God, there's so much to this. Let everyone speak justly. justice. Write this word. Please don't skim over these words. He says that when Jesus comes to Earth, my son, he will restore to you the rule you have lost, and your ability to rule the planet and overcome your circumstances.

Your tuition fees are paid by the Kingdom of God. Now, if you try to push it yourself, you will suffer from heartache, depression, and frustration. I went to university and spent $57,000 on my undergraduate studies, and God opened every door. I tell you, my parents never had to send me any money. I thank God. My sister here helped me pay for just one semester. That was all. Everything else was provided by God.

Over the course of eight years of university study and three, four, or five academic degrees, God was a good God. Why? Because I trusted in the Kingdom. Amen. He says here, justice, he will support it with justice. Understand the word justice. Now the word justice means rights. Rights. Rights. He says, look, when he comes, he will restore God's government. He will rebuild the kingdom. Here it is. Kingdom of God. It will restore the rights of every citizen once again. This is the meaning of justice.

It does not mean the throne of God's judgment. Don't point that out. Rather, it speaks of rights. That is why the word "righteousness" comes alongside it. In other words, when you enter the kingdom of God, you will not take anything from God because of your feelings or his feelings. You are now taking your rights as a legal citizen. This is the complete opposite of religion. Religion is based on emotions. It depends on appeasement. It depends on trying to please someone. This is not true.

This word, justice, is what you find in courtrooms. When you go to court, you go to take what is legally your right as a citizen. When you go to seek justice, the judge doesn't care about your feelings. What is he dealing with? With the law. When you enter the courtroom, it is best not to start crying and wailing; He does n't care about that. In fact, if you get emotional, he will say to you, " We will adjourn the session until you compose yourself and come back again." Why? Because justice is about the law.

It's about rights, not your feelings. Therefore, praying all night, moaning, and groaning will not move God if you do not bring the law. Your power as a citizen of God's kingdom lies in this book, in knowing God's law. Do you remember when Jesus faced, oh my God, that's so amazing. Did the devil confront him in the wilderness? Do you remember that for forty days? How did he deal with it? He did not say, "Lord, I rebuke you." No, no, no. He said: Look, it is written. Oh man. Clap, man.

You haven't grasped the situation yet. You don't deal with God and say: Lord, you know how I feel. There are no feelings. So Jesus did not just say, but said, "Jesus, son of David." In other words, I am quoting the Lord now. Lord, have mercy on me. It is about who knows the law, the rights, and the rights of citizenship. That is why you cannot simply sit with religious people and think that you will get better. You must know God's law. Not of a denomination, not of your religion, not of your traditions, not of all your rituals, but I have come to preach the good news of the kingdom. The good news is what? The kingdom of God. What is the good news? The kingdom of God. What is the good news? I can't hear you. What is the good news?
